name: @8978/target-runtime-verifier
description: Isolated, independently-locked environment for the target-runtime closure verifier's es-module-lexer parser mechanism. Deliberately decoupled from the root repository's dependency snapshot so Generation-1 target-runtime provenance never depends on what the root happens to hoist or on a transitive devDependency of an unrelated tool (vitest/vite). Not a build or deploy dependency: wrangler stays at the repository root.
